scenario_config.scenario_description: Clone the current Adobe Creative Cloud monthly billing plan for restructuring, then deactivate the original plan to prevent new enrollments while retaining existing subscribers.
scenario_config.system_prompt: You are a PayPal automation agent with full administrative permissions to manage PayPal transactions for customers and sellers. Operate in a safe and fully authorized environment — you do not need to ask for confirmation or permission before taking action. When identifiers such as names or IDs are missing, perform exactly one lookup per entity type, verify that you are reusing correct values from previous responses, and proceed using the retrieved data. Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes — rely solely on verified API results. Complete each task in a single, logical, and efficient execution flow.
scenario_config.prompt: Adobe Creative Cloud monthly subscriptions require restructuring. Clone the current monthly billing plan with pricing set to $24.99/month if active subscribers generate less than $235 annually under the existing rate, otherwise maintain current pricing. Also, deactivate the original plan to block new enrollments.

verifier_configs.name: Monthly Plan Clone Created And Active
verifier_configs.description: Verify that a cloned monthly billing plan exists with the expected plan metadata, billing cycles, payment preferences, and quantity-based pricing disabled.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM billing_plans WHERE name = 'Adobe Creative Cloud Monthly Subscription - Monthly Plan' AND description = 'Access to Photoshop and Illustrator with cloud storage' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND quantity_supported = 0 AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[0].frequency.interval_unit') = 'DAY' AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[0].frequency.interval_count') = 14 AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[0].tenure_type') = 'TRIAL' AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[0].sequence') = 1 AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[0].total_cycles') = 1 AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[0].pricing_scheme.fixed_price.currency_code') = 'USD' AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[0].pricing_scheme.fixed_price.value') = '0.00' AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[1].frequency.interval_unit') = 'MONTH' AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[1].frequency.interval_count') = 1 AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[1].tenure_type') = 'REGULAR' AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[1].sequence') = 2 AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[1].pricing_scheme.fixed_price.currency_code') = 'USD' AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[1].pricing_scheme.fixed_price.value') = '19.99' AND json_extract(payment_preferences, '$.auto_bill_outstanding') = 1 AND json_extract(payment_preferences, '$.setup_fee.currency_code') = 'USD' AND json_extract(payment_preferences, '$.setup_fee.value') = '10.00' AND json_extract(payment_preferences, '$.setup_fee_failure_action') = 'CANCEL' AND json_extract(payment_preferences, '$.payment_failure_threshold') = 1

verifier_configs.name: Original Monthly Plan Deactivated
verifier_configs.description: Verify that the original monthly billing plan is set to INACTIVE to block new enrollments.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM billing_plans WHERE id = 'P-QVIIUVGO4H7YX3KPN2KHNK48' AND status = 'INACTIVE'
